concerns.text: Task T001 creates required project directories but the verification script only checks the per‑sample schema; there is no test that asserts the listed directories (e.g., data/processed/, data/results/, figures/) actually exist. Add a verification step (e.g., a pytest that asserts `pathlib.Path('data/processed').is_dir()` etc.) so the deliverable is concretely verified.

Task T008 defines a reproducibility smoke test that compares `metrics_raw.csv` to a stored reference file `tests/reference/metrics_raw_ref.csv`, but no prior task creates or populates this reference file. The verification will always fail unless the reference is provided. Add a task that generates `metrics_raw_ref.csv` (e.g., after T005 on a clean run) and records its location.

Task T011 writes the outcome of the dependency install to `data/results/requirements_check.json`, but the verification test `test_requirements.py` expects a comparison between the captured installed package list and the pinned versions. The task does not specify that the JSON must contain the installed package list in a structured field; make this explicit (e.g., `{ "installed": ["pkg==x.y.z", …] }`).
